existingData: S08:111 obtains all storage rows after the finite GET. S08:113 calls noFurther; S08:30 calls count(f) after discard, and S08:22 has the entire post-denial snapshot BEFORE scopeState/restore. Today it retains only upload/activation/receipt counters. S09:153–157 already binds the private choice response to its captured request ID if firstState.trace exists. S09:379–385 instruments the QA catch with position and up to six stack frames, but that event contains no request ID. S09:405–424 correlator labels also lack invocation binding. firstConnectionProbe (S09:350–351) would be a new RPC/read here. S10:180,212–224 phase/provider response data identifies synthetic transport requests, not the upper denial guard. No discarded row, stack or scalar can be recovered from the closed digest.

alternatives.option: A — derive a persisted boundary from the two existing snapshots
alternatives.seam: At S08:22 use its existing optional observation argument only for the noFurther count belonging to the first drop of this form. Bind pre/post to this local noScope invocation (closure/object identity). Decode the known finite base for SHA256(form.handle) and check project/preconnection/revision against its canonical record. Compare corresponding post-only TicketUse, linked ConfigurationApproval and finite StageApproval. Validate each record and the complete predecessor chain against S01:244–259 and store 122bc0:66–92,123–142. Emit one finite milestone or UNKNOWN; never emit keys or hashes. No second snapshot or RPC. Compute after the original snapshot/counter operations, synchronously, with a bounded input and nonthrowing fallback. Close on the original count/finally.
alternatives.defines: Latest coherently linked record OBSERVED at that pre-restore read, for example TicketUse with no linked approval, or the finite StageApproval present. Missing/malformed predecessor, ambiguous linkage or overflow gives UNKNOWN. A reachable record proves persisted progress to at least its write; the following c.step recheck/readback can still fail (S01:153–159,176–178). An absent record proves only absence at the sampling instant. Late physical work and competing writers prevent attribution of a row to a particular response without extra evidence.
alternatives.cost: Smallest change: host-side S08 fixture/projection only; all business checks and existing calls retained. It changes a pinned fixture and requires explicit separate review. It locates an interval; it cannot identify the exact failed check.

alternatives.option: B — classify the existing QA denial catch for one exact forwarded invocation
alternatives.seam: Optional diagnostic-only S09 transform at its existing handler catch, immediately before S00:808 folds the error into pending. Use only the already caught error/position and existing captured stack. Bind one drop slot in S09:175–185 to one exact forwarded original POST/private-choice Request at S09:152–157. The identical Request object is passed through the factory and S02:25. An invocation-local token/WeakMap ties that request to the catch; do not select the newest global observation or pair arrays by time. A stricter selector can join its private cookie digest to the sole finite ticket already read in S09:164 and S08:111; ambiguous, repeated or mismatched candidates poison the slot. Keep one terminal classification; seal at the existing c2ScopeState cut and revoke on c2ScopeRestore/finally. Late or missing catches, duplicate requests, unknown mapping or a consumed slot give UNKNOWN. No added RPC or snapshot; a fixed private-lab marker emitted at that cut avoids changing RPC arguments/results. Marker visibility, absence of perturbation of original control flow, and bounded extraction would need future proof.
alternatives.defines: Only allow a symbolic label when the caught winning error has an unambiguous, preverified throw+caller location in the exact built QA bytes. Generated locations change with builds: S10:129 uses esbuild metafile, not a source-map guarantee. An entry/approved string, a generic shared fail function, a timer/abort stack or a malformed/unmapped trace cannot be turned into an exact inner guard. No arbitrary stack/message, identifier, request data or record leaves the fixture. QA stage alone does not prove the public M denial used that QA result: the outer bridge races its own original deadline or can reject before forwarding (f2c473:6–44; 38285f:26–39); the receiver can also reject before S00 (S02:12–26). A QA catch identifies its own rejection site only. Exact public causality additionally requires proof the same response won the outer operation; absent such a join, report UNKNOWN for public causality.
alternatives.cost: Higher than A: a change in the isolated QA fixture bundle, identity/closure validation, exact version-specific map and parent/OWN confirmation. Before consuming a business occurrence, demonstrate from pinned generated bytes that concrete sites can be distinguished; if no reliable map exists the option is insufficient. No release implied.

decision: Neither output chooses a repair on its own. A linked durable gap can restrict inspection to one storage interval. An exact QA refusal can select a specific candidate only when it identifies a reproducible defective input or implementation invariant, e.g. a concrete approval/readback mismatch independently reproduced with the same bindings. Then repair that proven fixture/store seam and retain the denial. A legitimate expiry or an unknown/pre-forward/timeout result warrants no relaxed guard or broader clock. Maintain HOLD while the cheaper static inspection remains possible. For exact public cause across both M and QA, the requested guarantee is infeasible from the surviving data and the single proposed QA cut.
capsCorrection: Previous design dcfa64df wire accidentally counted the framing LF inside 24576 bytes. R4 0465cae:512–513 limits the JSON body to 24576 UTF8 bytes, then appends one LF (payload maximum 24577). Correction to apply only if a future design is released; retain existing caps. No previous blob modified.
authority: Read-only static feasibility. Two alternatives, no new fixtures, code, execution or nomination. Source 4/5 and OWN 4/5.
